description: Implement a real 3-state (closed/open/half-open) circuit breaker in place of a stub that always calls through
prompts: Create src/CircuitBreaker.php defining namespace App, a CircuitOpenException extends \RuntimeException, and class CircuitBreaker with a constructor __construct(int $failureThreshold, int $resetTimeout). call(callable $fn, int $now) always just calls $fn() right now - implement the real 3-state machine instead: starts closed. In closed, call($fn, $now) invokes $fn(); if it throws, count consecutive failures, and once $failureThreshold CONSECUTIVE failures have happened, trip to open (recording when it opened) and re-throw. While open, call must NOT invoke $fn() at all and must instead throw CircuitOpenException - UNLESS at least $resetTimeout seconds have passed since it opened, in which case it moves to half-open and allows exactly ONE trial call: if that call succeeds, go back to closed (reset the failure count); if it throws, go back to open and RESET the open-time to $now (so the next trial is only allowed after another full resetTimeout, not immediately).

reference_solution.src/CircuitBreaker.php:
<?php
namespace App;

class CircuitOpenException extends \RuntimeException {}

class CircuitBreaker
{
    private int $failureThreshold;
    private int $resetTimeout;
    private string $state = 'closed';
    private int $failures = 0;
    private int $openedAt = 0;

    public function __construct(int $failureThreshold, int $resetTimeout)
    {
        $this->failureThreshold = $failureThreshold;
        $this->resetTimeout = $resetTimeout;
    }

    public function call(callable $fn, int $now)
    {
        if ($this->state === 'open') {
            if ($now - $this->openedAt < $this->resetTimeout) {
                throw new CircuitOpenException();
            }
            $this->state = 'half_open';
        }

        try {
            $result = $fn();
        } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
            if ($this->state === 'half_open') {
                $this->state = 'open';
                $this->openedAt = $now;
            } else {
                $this->failures++;
                if ($this->failures >= $this->failureThreshold) {
                    $this->state = 'open';
                    $this->openedAt = $now;
                }
            }
            throw $e;
        }

        $this->state = 'closed';
        $this->failures = 0;
        return $result;
    }
}

test_setup_files.tests/CircuitBreakerTest.php:
<?php
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/CircuitBreaker.php';

final class CircuitBreakerTest extends TestCase
{
    public function boom()
    {
        throw new \RuntimeException("boom");
    }

    public function testTripsOpenAfterConsecutiveFailures(): void
    {
        $b = new \App\CircuitBreaker(3, 10);
        for ($i = 0; $i < 3; $i++) {
            try {
                $b->call([$this, 'boom'], 0);
                $this->fail('expected exception');
            } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
                $this->assertSame('boom', $e->getMessage());
            }
        }
        $this->expectException(\App\CircuitOpenException::class);
        $b->call(fn() => 'should not run', 0);
    }

    public function testFailsFastWithoutCallingFnWhileOpen(): void
    {
        $b = new \App\CircuitBreaker(1, 100);
        try {
            $b->call([$this, 'boom'], 0);
        } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
        }
        $called = false;
        try {
            $b->call(function () use (&$called) { $called = true; return 'x'; }, 1);
            $this->fail('expected CircuitOpenException');
        } catch (\App\CircuitOpenException $e) {
        }
        $this->assertFalse($called);
    }

    public function testHalfOpenTrialAfterTimeoutSuccessCloses(): void
    {
        $b = new \App\CircuitBreaker(1, 10);
        try {
            $b->call([$this, 'boom'], 0);
        } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
        }
        $this->assertSame('ok', $b->call(fn() => 'ok', 10));
        $this->assertSame('still-fine', $b->call(fn() => 'still-fine', 11));
    }

    public function testHalfOpenFailureReopensAndResetsClock(): void
    {
        $b = new \App\CircuitBreaker(1, 10);
        try {
            $b->call([$this, 'boom'], 0);
        } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
        }
        try {
            $b->call([$this, 'boom'], 10);
            $this->fail('expected boom at half-open trial');
        } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
            $this->assertSame('boom', $e->getMessage());
        }
        try {
            $b->call(fn() => 'too soon', 15);
            $this->fail('expected CircuitOpenException at t=15');
        } catch (\App\CircuitOpenException $e) {
        }
        $this->assertSame('ok now', $b->call(fn() => 'ok now', 20));
    }
}
